text:
ENERĞIĞ AL-YAWN AL-AAMM
Tatamışyouna al-yawm taqah ijyabiyyah wa mudeheshah tanzour ala bourj al-mizan, mima yaj'al al-hawwa' al-moheet bika mali'an bil-safaa' wa al-tawazon al-lathee touhibbuhu dayman. Inaha fatrah munasibah jiddan li-i'adat al-hisabat al-shakhsiyah wa tarteeb al-awlawiyat bi-hudoo' w wadouh tam. Roohuka al-mardeeyyah al-yawm tatamatta' bi-injazat jadidah wa qodrah fareedah ala fasl al-mushkilat bi-hikmah balighah. Sa tash'our bi-rahat nafsiyah aameeqah tunasheto kulla khaliyah fi jasadika wa tandofa'ka nahwa al-tafakkor al-eejyabi.

AL-HUBB WA AL-ALAQAT
Lil-murتبطeen, al-yawm yahmilu ma'ahu ajwa' min al-romansiyah al-haqeeqiyah wa al-tafahhom al-mutebadal allathee yu'azziz al-rabet al-zawji aw al-atefi bi-shakl la yuwasaf. Inaha forsah thamineh li-tahqeeq ta'beer aameeq an al-masha'er al-dafi'ah w tajdeed al-wu'ood baynakuma ba'da fatrat furoogh basetah. Amma al-'ozzaab, fa-al-falak yushir ila ihtimaliyat liqa' ghair mutawaqqa' qad yuqallib al-mawayeen rasاً 'ala 'aqib wa yajlib al-farah ila qulubihim. Kon musta'iddan li-ištiaq al-quloub wa da' al-imkaniyat al-jamilah tatasalal ila hayatika bi-tabi'atiha al-hadi'ah.

AL-AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Fi majal al-a'mal, taqif al-yawm amama abwab waasi'ah li-l-taqaddom wa al-ibda' al-fanni aw al-mahani allathee tubdi'u feeh dayman. Ihtarith faqat min al-taraddod al-mufrad allathee qad yu'eefu qadamayka 'an ikhtiyar al-qarar al-munasib fi al-waqt al-munasib. Foras jadidah li-l-ta'awon al-mushtarak qad tazhar amamaka, fa-la taraddad fi qoboul al-mas'ooliyat al-mutazayidah li-annaka qadir 'alayha bikol kifayah. Inaha fatrah mithaliyah li-ithbat nafsika wa abraz mawahebika al-fareedah amam al-rumaa' wa al-moudireen.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-mali yahmilu lakum al-yawm istiqraran malhuzan yumkinoka min tanzeem omourik al-maliyah bi-akthar tariqah zaka' wa wa'i. Qad tatلقى khabaran sarran yakhusso ziyadah fi al-dakhl aw forsah istithmariyah naajihah tunasheto marahil al-mustaqbal. Rughm thalika, unsaheeduka bi-tajnoub al-shira' al-'atifi aw al-infaq al-za'ed 'ala ashya' ghair dharuriyah. Haafiz 'ala al-tawazon bayn al-istimtaa' bil-mal wa hifzihi lil-mustaqbal al-qareeb.

AL-SIHHAH WA AL-TAQA
Sihhatuka al-badaniyah wa al-nafisiyah fi afdal ahwaliha al-yawm shart an tuti'a nida' jasadika wa ta'tiyahu al-raha al-kafiyah. Numaww al-taqah al-ijyabiyyah yata'allaqu bi-mudawamatika ala shurb al-ma' wa mumarasat al-riyadah al-khafifah mithl al-mashy fi al-hawa' al-taliq. Uhris 'ala al-ibta'ad 'an masadir al-tawattor al-kharijiyah wa imla' waqtaka bil-an-shoutah al-fanniyah aw al-musiqa allati tuhibbha. Al-zihn al-safi yata'allaq bi-qadratika ala al-istirkha' wa al-tanaffos al-'ameeq.

AL-TAWASUL WA AL-MUHEET
Hayatuka al-ijtima'iyah tatamatta' al-yawm bi-nashad rayi' wa quwwah jadhibiyah khassah tajzul ilayka al-asdiqa' wal-a'ila. Inaha fatrah rayi'ah li-qada' awqat mumti'ah ma' al-ahbab aw hal al-khilafat al-qadimah bi-tikr al-safah al-jadeed. Al-kalam al-tayyib allathee tutliquhu sayasna' atharan tayyiban fi nufous al-muheetin bika, mimma yaj'alaka mahboulan wa mawdou' i'timad dayman. Isma' li-nasa'ih man yuhibbunaka fa-indmahum al-kheer al-katheer.

NASIHAT AL-YAWN
"La taqlaq bi-sha'n al-ghad, fa-kol khutwah takhtutuha al-yawm bi-wa'i tasna' mustaqbalaka al-mushreq bi-hudooj."

TAFASEEL AL-YAWN
Al-raqam al-hazeez: 6
Al-lawn al-hazeez: Al-Azraq al-Samawi
Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Al-Jawzaa'
